description: This script sets up and tests Git's behavior concerning line endings (CRLF) during merge conflict scenarios in a repository. It defines test steps to verify if merge strategies correctly handle CRLF line endings and conflicts.

methods.name: append_cr
methods.description: Appends a carriage return character to the output stream, used to simulate CRLF line endings.

methods.name: remove_cr
methods.description: Removes carriage return characters from the input stream, used for comparison of normalized line endings.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the subsequent command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
